Page 1 is a cover sheet, page 2 a table of contents and page 3 a definitions page where 'the Customer' and 'the Supplier' are defined by cross-reference to the signature page. It should land in _no-name-found (or _not-sure) and stay unresolved - guessing the account from the 'THP/2023/ELEC-11' reference or the 'THP-LEGAL' document control string is exactly the behaviour this file is built to catch. A second trap: 42 pages must be read in ranges, and the layered Schedule 2 must be found before the dates are answered.

Sturmore Rail Group.what_governs_today: The Master Supply Agreement dated 22 February 2021 (SRG/PROC/2021/114), as amended by Amendment No. 1 dated 6 June 2023. Commenced 1 March 2021; initial three-year term, then year to year; no notice served, so live at 7 September 2026.
Sturmore Rail Group.payment_terms: 60 days from the end of the month in which the invoice is dated.
Sturmore Rail Group.freight_terms: Free of carriage on orders with a net value of GBP 250 or more; below that a GBP 22.50 carriage charge. Exception: deliveries to the Kellerby Interchange site compound are free of carriage whatever the order value, until practical completion (programmed 30 June 2027).
Sturmore Rail Group.notice_period: Six months' written notice, expiring at any time (cl.2.2).

questions.q: What payment term applies to an invoice dated today?
questions.a: 60 days from the end of the month of invoice, not the 45 days printed in the master.
questions.evidence: Amendment No. 1, cl.1.1: "The Supplier shall be paid within 60 days from the end of the month in which the invoice is dated."

questions.q: Does condition 14 on the back of PO 88231 displace the master?
questions.a: No. It is boilerplate precedence wording on a single order; the master is signed by both parties and clause 11.1 orders the same conflict the other way. The card and the form both direct the reader to ignore prevails-over-orders wording.
questions.evidence: PO 88231 reverse, cl.14: "These Conditions apply to the exclusion of all other terms and prevail over any master agreement"; master cl.11.1: "this Agreement prevails, then the Order, then the Supplier's conditions of sale".

questions.q: Is the carriage-free threshold GBP 250 or GBP 500?
questions.a: GBP 250. The GBP 500 figure exists only in an unsigned draft amendment.
questions.evidence: Master cl.8.1: "Delivery is free of carriage on Orders with a net value of GBP 250 or more"; Amendment No. 2 draft, cl.2.1: "This draft has not been agreed and creates no obligation unless and until it is signed by both parties."

Wexbury Utilities plc.what_governs_today: The Framework Agreement dated 12 May 2022 (WU/2022/EL-07). It was signed by Wexbury alone, but Wexbury confirmed in writing on 4 September 2024 that it trades under it and we served notice under its clause 3.2 on 14 August 2026. Live at 7 September 2026 and ending 14 February 2027. The 2026 rebate letter runs alongside it for that calendar year only.
Wexbury Utilities plc.payment_terms: 60 days from the end of the month in which the invoice is dated (cl.6.1). The 90 days in 'Signed final.pdf' is a draft figure and is not the term.
Wexbury Utilities plc.freight_terms: Delivery included in the price for call offs with a net value of GBP 150 or more; below that carriage at our published rate (cl.7.1).
Wexbury Utilities plc.notice_period: Six months for convenience (cl.3.2) - already served, expiring 14 February 2027.

questions.a: By Wexbury only. Our execution block on the signature page is blank - no name, no title, no date. The gap is bridged by conduct and by the customer's own written confirmation, not by a signature.
questions.evidence: Wexbury letter, 4 September 2024: "We confirm that we are trading under the terms of the Framework Agreement dated 12 May 2022".

questions.q: When does trading under the framework end?
questions.a: 14 February 2027. It is live today; the termination letter is prospective.
questions.evidence: Notice of 14 August 2026: "The six month notice period runs from the date of this letter and the Agreement will therefore end on 14 February 2027."

questions.q: Does the 2026 rebate letter set the trading terms?
questions.a: No. It sets 1.75 per cent above GBP 400,000 for the 2026 calendar year and nothing else; section B rule 6 keeps a period-only letter out of 1-governs-trade.
questions.evidence: Rebate letter, para 4: "This letter sets the rebate for the 2026 calendar year only. It does not vary the prices, the payment term, the carriage arrangement or any other trading term".

Ardleigh Marine Systems Limited.what_governs_today: The Master Supply Agreement dated 15 September 2025 (AMS/2025/MSA), commenced 1 October 2025, rolling, live. It replaced the 2019 Supply Agreement made in the customer's former name, Colverne Marine Engineering Limited. Brenlow Dockyard Services Limited is a separate counterparty whose own master died on 30 April 2026.
Ardleigh Marine Systems Limited.payment_terms: 45 days from the date of the invoice (cl.6.1).
Ardleigh Marine Systems Limited.freight_terms: Free of carriage on orders with a net value of GBP 300 or more; below that a GBP 28.00 carriage charge (cl.7.1).
Ardleigh Marine Systems Limited.notice_period: Twelve months' written notice for convenience (cl.12.1).

questions.q: Is the ERP counterparty the same legal person as the 2019 counterparty?
questions.a: Yes - a change of name only, same company number 06421889, no transfer of business.
questions.evidence: Name change letter, 2 February 2021: "changed its name from Colverne Marine Engineering Limited to Ardleigh Marine Systems Limited with effect from 25 January 2021".

questions.q: Which document governs, and from when?
questions.a: The 2025 master, from 1 October 2025. The 2019 agreement is dead from that date.
questions.evidence: Executed MSA cl.2.2: "This Agreement supersedes and replaces the Supply Agreement dated 9 April 2019 between the parties with effect from the Commencement Date".

questions.q: Is anything live for Brenlow Dockyard Services?
questions.a: No. Its master was terminated for convenience with effect from 30 April 2026, and nothing in any document puts Brenlow inside the Ardleigh group.
questions.evidence: Fax of 24 March 2026: "In accordance with clause 12.1 the Agreement will end on 30 April 2026"; Brenlow master cl.1.2: "No parent, subsidiary or associated company of the Customer may order under it."

Trentmoor Housing Partnership.what_governs_today: The Master Supply Agreement dated 5 September 2023 (THP/2023/ELEC-11), commenced 1 October 2023; the three-year initial term runs to 30 September 2026 and it then continues until twelve months' notice. Live. Three live overlays sit alongside it: the Supply Agreement (Meter Cabinets) dated 4 July 2022 for that product set, the Larkhall Court Site Services Agreement dated 11 March 2026 for those Works, and the Kellerby Interchange joint letter for that site's carriage. The 2022 NDA is live but does not govern trade.
Trentmoor Housing Partnership.payment_terms: 60 days from the end of the month of invoice (cl.9.1). For Larkhall Court Works invoices, 30 days from the end of the month (site agreement cl.4.2, which prevails for the Works). For meter cabinets, 45 days from the date of invoice.
Trentmoor Housing Partnership.freight_terms: Free of carriage to the Schedule 3 sites on orders of GBP 200 net or more; otherwise carriage at cost (cl.7.3). Free at any value to the Larkhall Court compound and to the Kellerby Interchange compound. Carriage is included in the meter cabinet prices.
Trentmoor Housing Partnership.notice_period: Twelve months' written notice after the initial term (cl.22.1). The site agreement runs on thirty days' notice; the meter cabinet agreement on six months'.

questions.q: What price applies to an order placed on 5 January 2027 if no new Schedule 2 has been issued?
questions.a: List price less 22 per cent. Schedule 2 expires on 31 December 2026 and its expiry does not end the agreement.

questions.q: What payment term applies to a Larkhall Court invoice?
questions.a: 30 days from the end of the month, not the master's 60.
questions.evidence: Site agreement cl.6.2: "this Agreement prevails in respect of the Works, and the Master Agreement prevails for everything else".

questions.q: Are meter cabinets bought under the 2023 master?

questions.evidence: Master cl.26.2: "This Agreement does not affect the Supply Agreement (Meter Cabinets) dated 4 July 2022 between the parties, which continues in force".
